summary: TSMC Q1 2026 (reported April 16, 2026): profit +58% YoY, beat estimates, fresh record. Full-year 2026 revenue growth guidance: >30% YoY (USD). HPC segment = 61% of Q1 revenue (up from 55%), includes AI chips for Nvidia. 2026 capex upper end of guidance. AI demand at capacity limits. AMD Q1 2026 beat (May 5) re-ignited TSM rally. Next earnings expected mid-July 2026.
